# La Mesa — Ceramics Studio & Creative Lab

> La Mesa is a ceramics studio and multidisciplinary creative lab located in La Barceloneta, Barcelona. We offer weekly classes, drop-in sessions, wheel throwing courses, creative workshops and private sessions. Tone: welcoming, informal, community-focused. We are hosts, not teachers.

## Services
- Taller Semanal Modelado (weekly hand-building class): €120/month — 4 sessions of 2h, 1×/week. Access enrollment through the Mesana client area.
- Taller Semanal Torno (weekly wheel-throwing class): €120/month — 4 sessions of 2h, 1×/week. Access enrollment through the Mesana client area.
- Clase Suelta Modelado (drop-in hand-building): €45 — one 2-hour class. Book and pay online (Stripe) on the hand-building page; WhatsApp is the fallback.
- Clase Suelta Torno (drop-in wheel, private, max 2 people): €65 — one 2-hour class. Book and pay online (Stripe) on the wheel page; WhatsApp is the fallback.
- Bono de horas (hour pack, hand-building or wheel, used at your own pace): 8h €120, 16h €220, 24h €300. Buy online via Mesana (https://app.mesana.studio/book/la-mesa).
- Creative workshops (with guest artists): variable, see website.
- Private sessions (team building, birthdays, bachelorette): custom quote.
- Handmade tableware for restaurants and custom ceramics: small plates, plates, bowls and cups in high-fire stoneware, made to order in custom sizes and colours. Purchase (no minimum order, volume discounts, shipping across Europe) or rental for 4, 6 or 12 months (Barcelona area only, delivery and collection included). Lead time: a few weeks. Price on quote via WhatsApp or email.

All materials and firings included. High-temperature clay. Full machine-readable pricing: https://lamesabcn.com/pricing.md

## Booking
- Weekly classes: enrollment and account access use the Mesana client area at https://app.mesana.studio/client/la-mesa.
- Single classes: the public calendars show actual Mesana dates, prices and live available places. Choose a session and pay online (Stripe) to book; the price comes from Mesana. If the calendar cannot load, the page falls back to a WhatsApp request.
- Single-class calendars: pottery wheel https://lamesabcn.com/experiencias/torno.html · hand-building https://lamesabcn.com/experiencias/modelado.html (the former Clase Suelta page redirects to the wheel page). Public Modelado is €45.
- Hour pack (bono de horas): online via Mesana at https://app.mesana.studio/book/la-mesa.
- WhatsApp (https://wa.me/34711552030): creative workshops and private sessions.

## Opening Hours
Closed Monday and Sunday. Same hours as the Google Business Profile (Europe/Madrid):
- Tuesday: 11:00–19:00
- Wednesday: 11:00–20:30
- Thursday: 11:00–19:00
- Friday: 11:00–19:00
- Saturday: 11:00–16:00

Clase Suelta (Modelado or Torno): Tuesday to Saturday, at the time the customer prefers within opening hours, subject to availability (wheels are limited to 2). Book and pay online (Stripe) on the experiencias pages for a published date; if the preferred time is not shown or the calendar cannot load, ask the studio via WhatsApp.

## Languages
Website: Spanish (primary), English, Catalan, Portuguese. Classes are taught in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

## Pottery class for visitors to Barcelona
Main pages: pottery wheel https://lamesabcn.com/en/experiencias/torno.html · hand-building https://lamesabcn.com/en/experiencias/modelado.html (ES https://lamesabcn.com/experiencias/torno.html · CA https://lamesabcn.com/ca/experiencias/torno.html · PT https://lamesabcn.com/pt/clases/suelta.html)
- 2-hour pottery class in La Barceloneta, no experience needed: hand-building €45 or private wheel throwing for up to 2 people €65. Book online with a live calendar and secure payment (Stripe).
- Taught in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
- Clay, tools, glazes and firing included. The piece is ready 15 days after the class; if the visitor leaves Barcelona sooner, La Mesa can ship it to their home (shipping price on request via WhatsApp).
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the class.
- From 8 years old. The studio is wheelchair accessible.
- Address: Carrer de l'Atlàntida 47, La Barceloneta, Barcelona — a short walk from the beach and from Barceloneta metro (L4).
- Reviews: 5.0 on Google (41 reviews, September 2026). Also listed on Tripadvisor and GetYourGuide.

## About
Founded by Lau and Vick. La Mesa is not a traditional school — it is a creative space where people come to make things with their hands, connect with others, and slow down. All materials and firings included. High-temperature clay.

## Personalised ceramic gifts
- Handmade to order at La Mesa in La Barceloneta, Barcelona; orders from one piece.
- Indicative starting price: €40. Final quote depends on the piece, dimensions and design.
- Personalisation: names, dates, messages, drawings, colours, dimensions and custom shapes, agreed before production.
- Production: 2–3 weeks AFTER the design is agreed, not from the initial enquiry; transport time is additional.
- Collection at Carrer de l’Atlàntida 47, Barcelona, or shipping. Confirm destination, shipping cost, terms and transport time via WhatsApp.
- Enquiries and quotes: https://wa.me/34711552030
- Guide (ES): https://lamesabcn.com/blog/regalos-ceramica-personalizados-barcelona.html
- Guide (EN): https://lamesabcn.com/blog/personalised-ceramic-gifts-barcelona.html
